title: Demo house: team member's home (not an SDP site)
source: export_30000.ply (ImageToStl, xyz only, 1,126,007 vertices); prepared by scripts/prepare_twin.py

scale.method: Architectural prior on the primary house. Measured eave 0.921 u and ridge 1.282 u above the terrain model (ratio 1.39 -> 2-storey). Eave ~6.2 m gives 6.73 m/u, ridge ~9.5 m gives 7.41 m/u; geometric mean used. Segmentation is re-run at the estimated scale until it agrees within 6% (fixed point; used 7.029 m/u). Independent cross-checks (porch roof edge, footprint, trees) in scale.crossChecks.

crossChecks.typical: MY double-storey bungalow/semi-D: eave 5.8-6.6 m, ridge 8.5-10.5 m, car-porch roof edge 2.7-3.5 m, footprint 10-20 m a side; mature rain trees 10-20 m.

location.name: Ara Damansara (assumed, for sun angles only)

alignment.method: PCA least-variance axis, sign from the roofs-cover-walls test (sloped planar patches sit above the adjacent vertical ones), refined so near-vertical planar patches are exactly vertical; heading from wall normals folded mod 90 deg; -z = north is a convention only.

occupancy.encoding: uint8, 1 = solid, x fastest then y then z

occluders.kind: structure (wall, pole or other building part)
